promise: Direct the image, choose the draft, and refine the actual file.
audience: People and agents creating or refining visual assets with explicit artifact review.
trigger: Use when directing an image, choosing and refining concrete drafts, delivering an artifact pack, or converting image and ASCII art.

modes.name: Fast
modes.when: One clear low-risk image or edit with an available tool.
modes.output: One concrete file with technical checks and visual review at the capability actually available.

modes.name: Guided
modes.when: One meaningful creative or technical ambiguity.
modes.output: Focused direction or parameter judgment, then a checked draft.

modes.name: Studio
modes.when: A campaign, batch, reference asset, costly output, or consequential edit needs review.
modes.output: Approved brief/cost plan, selected artifacts, anchored refinements, and final artifact pack.

modes.name: ASCII
modes.when: The intended artifact is characters or a rasterized text composition.
modes.output: A local luminance-mapped text/HTML artifact or rasterization with no generation required when a source exists.

examples.title: The approved cup stays the approved cup
examples.brief: A fictional studio chooses draft cup-A, then requests a small label correction.
examples.before: Rerun the same prompt at higher quality and deliver the resulting different composition as the approved image.
examples.after: Edit cup-A or its last accepted descendant, retain parent/hash lineage, show the new exact file, and keep visual QA pending if the model cannot see its pixels.
examples.why: Approval belongs to a concrete artifact. Reusing a prompt creates a new candidate.

boundaries: Installing the portable method starts no service, uploads no image, and calls no paid provider.
The native adapter speaks only MCP to an independently installed server. It imports no provider-server package and searches no sibling checkout.
Model names, costs, sizes, safety behavior, and tool arguments must be checked against live schemas and current authoritative provider documentation.
Studio approval and draft selection are existing workflow gates. Preserve prior user approvals at their exact scope.

verification.name: Native adapter regression suite
verification.command: python -m pytest -q -p pytest_asyncio.plugin -p pytest_cov.plugin --cov=amplifier_module_tool_imagen --cov-fail-under=80 modules/tool-imagen/tests (plugin autoload disabled)
verification.evidence: 36 passed, 1 opt-in checkout-contract test skipped; 85.33% line coverage. Provider-free MCP lifecycle, discovery, schema, timeout, error and cleanup tests.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Retained deterministic policy record
verification.evidence: Exact July result reproduces: 5/5 typed policy cases, 5/5 unsafe mutations rejected. All seven bound apparatus files and dated result unchanged. This is deterministic fixture evidence, not stochastic-model effectiveness.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Native and portable workflow checks
verification.command: python scripts/validate_bundle.py; python -m pytest -q -p pytest_asyncio.plugin evals/test_behavioral_harness.py tests (plugin autoload disabled)
verification.evidence: Static 5 YAML/1 canonical skill/12 scenarios; 6 tests pass, including local behavior and synthetic image→ASCII/HTML→PNG. No generation or real-user visual acceptance.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Independent executable MCP contract
verification.evidence: Actual client adapter initialized an independently installed server, discovered/validated exactly 8 reviewed schemas, and cleaned up. Provider keys removed; no client tool call or provider package import.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Current style and frozen apparatus
verification.command: ruff check scripts tests modules/tool-imagen evals; ruff format --check scripts tests modules/tool-imagen evals
verification.evidence: Local Ruff configuration makes checks independent of parent workspace defaults. Frozen byte-hashed July harness is excluded from formatting/import resorting; all other selected Python passes. Shared generated HTML literal and Python-compatible timezone spelling have narrow style exceptions.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Canonical reference mirror gate
verification.evidence: Original production/ASCII bodies, native router/policy/schema generated into portable references; source/output hashes prevent hand-maintained drift.
verification.expected: The declared check scope passes without a broader benefit claim.

verification.name: Portable build and clean install
verification.evidence: Canonical ZIP bytes, local links, complete method/license, clean install and idempotent reinstall pass. No runtime starts.

verification.name: Explicit local native configuration
verification.command: uv run --with PyYAML python scripts/local_runtime.py --output .capability-check/imagen-studio.yaml; Foundation load_bundle/validate_bundle
verification.evidence: Absolute local skill/module paths resolve; actual Foundation loader accepts YAML behavior with 2 tools and no provider/session. No activation.
verification.expected: Local configuration accepted by actual loader.
